rows.question: What is the exit load for HDFC Mid Cap Fund?
rows.text:
The exit load is 1.00% if units are redeemed or switched out within 1 year from the date of allotment, and no exit load applies after 1 year.

Source: https://files.hdfcfund.com/s3fs-public/2026-10/HDFC%20MF%20Factsheet%20-%20September%202026.pdf?VersionId=xjdQxQp4UEchOirw4TsCE9jEGenOREzw
